turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste ji, main aapke collections ke baare mein baat karne call kiya hu.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Ji sir, mera cheque book aur PO se related sawaal hai.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Theek hai, NACH aur TDS certificate check karke batata hu.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Ji, user ID ke saath VeloTatkal bhi dekh lijiye. Aur tokenised card ka bhi zara dekh lijiye.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Bilkul, KhedInvoice aur NirSankhya verify karke update deta hu.
